name: Bearing
description: A block that spins a whole structure attached to it.

pages.title: Bearing
pages.text:
A **bearing** is a mover that spins the structure glued to its face as a contraption.\
\
The Mechanical Bearing turns drills and turntables, the Windmill Bearing spins Windcatchers for power, the Propeller Bearing pushes ships and the Swivel Bearing turns a sub-ship. Reverse the input and it turns the other way.
